_comment: Recorded LIVE key sets for each venue's 24h-ticker endpoint. Consumed by scripts/check-paid-route-validation.mjs (R2), which asserts every `ticker.<field>` an adapter reads actually exists in that venue's recording. SEC-11 (OPS-AUDIT-REMEDIATION-MEDIUM-W1 Ch3): the Aster adapter read `prevClosePrice`, a Binance SPOT-only field its perp ticker never returns, so `?? 0` silently zeroed the 15%-weight momentum term on a PROMOTED venue with nothing logged and no fallback fired. A recorded key set turns that class into a build failure.
_how_to_add_a_venue: curl the venue's 24h-ticker endpoint, `jq -c 'keys'` (or `.data[0] | keys` for an envelope), and paste the array verbatim with the probe date + the exact URL. Never hand-edit a key list — the whole point is that it came from the venue. Per the CLAUDE.md per-venue-divergence LAW, never copy another venue's field names.
_unrecorded_are_reported_not_ignored: An adapter whose venue has no recording is REPORTED as unverified on every run, never silently passed. binance + bybit are unrecorded because their APIs TCP-block this operator's host (documented); record them from a host that can reach them — tracked as OPS-VENUE-TICKER-KEYS-EXTEND-W{NEXT}.

aster.note: prevClosePrice is ABSENT — it is a Binance SPOT-only field. openPrice IS present and is the 24h-rolling open. priceChangePercent is a percent-NUMBER, not a fraction (live-verified: last 64031.2, open 64351.5, pcp -0.498, (last-open)/open = -0.4977%).

bitget.note: Envelope response — keys taken from .data[0]. 24h open is `open24h`.

okx.note: Envelope response — keys taken from .data[0]. 24h open is `open24h`; `last` (not lastPrice).
